title: Development Order — DK Bond Tracker (implementation sequencing of AF-01..AF-37)
purpose: Sequence the 37 atomic functions into implementation waves for the post-design build (Stage 11 territory). Topological rule: every depends_on AF lands in an EARLIER or SAME wave. One wave completes and merges before the next begins. Each wave carries local pytest gates; no CI exists (honest).
sequence_rules: Topological: dep AF in earlier or same wave (verified by self-check against the AF graph)
SERIES execution: wave N fully green before wave N+1 starts
Per-wave gate: wave's pytest subset GREEN + store gates green locally; no remote tier configured
Error surfacing (AF-30) and schema decoupling (AF-29) are foundational: no code ships that swallows errors or keys off header text/position
Holds block only their acceptance, not their build: AF-08 is built in W1 but its reconciliation acceptance stays pending (L1); AF-37 is built in W7 but P&L acceptance stays pending (L2)

waves.name: Foundation
waves.entry_criteria: repo layout per architecture building_blocks (src/, tests/), .venv with openpyxl + flask + pytest, empty SQLite DB created by AF-01 schema init
waves.exit_criteria: AF-01 creates bonds/payment_ledger/home_plan schema; AF-02 opens + normalizes workbook (sheet-name trim, header-keyword detection); AF-29 header/position decoupling rules enforced; AF-30 error-surfacing wrapper raises named errors (no silent swallow)
waves.rationale: Roots of the AF graph (no deps); everything else builds on schema + reader + error discipline

waves.name: Import pipeline
waves.exit_criteria: bond master / payment grid / home plan / watch list extracted from the REAL XLSM with runtime-derived 83-month header grid; validation (dup ISIN full set, AF-28) runs; AF-08 reconcile REPORTS against baseline and flags L1 mismatch (never force-matches); AF-09 commits a full import atomically; reconciliation acceptance explicitly PENDING L1
waves.hold: L1: TC-26 stays pending_baseline until the owner re-baselines the exit figures (28500.00/-521500.00 vs 28500.00/-521500.00); wave exit requires all gates EXCEPT TC-26 (documented)
waves.rationale: Critical path AF-02->AF-03->AF-07->AF-09; import is the sole data source for everything downstream

waves.name: Ledger + status engine
waves.entry_criteria: W1 green (or W1 import committed; AF-01 from W0 strictly required)
waves.exit_criteria: ledger CRUD + portfolio totals as queries; D5 status rules exact (Danger = ANY unpaid past month, not just previous month; Completed overrides when months paid >= tenure; zero = unpaid; derived never stored); recompute-after-change and recompute-all pass the status matrix
waves.rationale: Core domain logic; deps (AF-01/10/11/14) all satisfied; feeds dashboard + grid + reinvestment

waves.name: Dashboard queries + route
waves.exit_criteria: five dashboard query modules + server-rendered route; live figures on every request (no snapshot); this-month dynamic; 83-month history with current month highlighted; status overview ordered Danger -> On-going -> Completed with colors; unresolvable-month shows explicit message (never blank)
waves.rationale: All deps (AF-10/13/14) in W2; pure query layer before UI binding

waves.name: Grid UI + launch + payment flow
waves.entry_criteria: W3 green (dashboard serves) — AF-23 itself only needs AF-01, but is grouped here as the user-visible slice
waves.exit_criteria: one-command launch serves the app; month grid renders from payment_ledger with row colors (paid green / due light red); payment POST inserts or corrects + recompute status + redirect; full launch->grid->edit->dashboard loop green
waves.rationale: deps AF-12/14/10/15 all in W2; completes the MVP loop (FR-02/03/04/18/19/20/24)

waves.name: CSV export
waves.entry_criteria: W4 green (same rows displayed as exported)
waves.exit_criteria: current-view + full-ledger CSV export; RFC-4180 quoting, UTF-8, matches displayed rows exactly
waves.rationale: deps AF-01 only; deliberately after the grid so exported rows equal rendered rows

waves.name: Phase 3 features
waves.entry_criteria: W1 green (AF-05/AF-06 extracted data) + W2 green (status for free-up)
waves.exit_criteria: home plan schedule reproduces incl. irregular savings; watch list analytics formulas match Excel outputs; reinvestment free-up: Completed bonds release principal (duplicate-deduction only for On-going/Danger)
waves.rationale: PRD Phase 3 scope (FR-11/FR-12) plus AF-33 (FR-17 reinvestment free-up) which the PRD assigns to Phase 1 - delivered here because its dependency AF-14 only lands in W2; not a phase-order violation

waves.name: Phase 4 features
waves.exit_criteria: discount calc, TDS deduction, quarterly/yearly payout cycles, dashboard P&L/ongoing TL value; performance check NFR-11 <2s @ 150x96
waves.hold: L2: AF-37 P&L acceptance stays pending until the owner confirms the definition (Stage-7 proposal: Till Return - Investment; alternative: maturity - investment); build may proceed, acceptance may not
waves.rationale: PRD Phase 4 scope; payout-cycle changes touch ledger/status — regression TCs (TC-53/54) run here

holds.issue: Import reconciliation acceptance cannot go green until the owner re-baselines the PRD exit figures (workbook 28500.00 / -521500.00 vs PRD 28500.00 / -521500.00) and settles the Balance definition (L=K-J vs Investment-TillReturn)
P&L definition proposed in Stage 7 (Till Return - Investment) awaits owner confirmation before Phase 4 acceptance; TC-40 (FR-16, full) is the holding test

verification.per_wave: pytest tests/ -k <wave scope> locally + store-projector --verify + store-gates --all --strict at each wave close
verification.full_regression: after W4 (MVP loop) and after W7 (final): complete TC suite locally; TC-26 (L1) and TC-40 (L2) remain pending until L1/L2 settle; TC-52 stays a normal planned Phase-3 UAT

done_criteria: All waves W0..W7 green except held acceptances L1/L2; coverage stays 42/42; every AF implemented exactly once in its wave; final regression runs with honest reds only on the two held TCs (or zero reds once L1/L2 settle)
